title: 第743章 同为旁系第742章 方家主脉
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 与此同时，乌衣巷内的院落中。
青玉琅琊桌上摆着一盘稀稀落落的果子，其中的灵气几乎已经消散殆尽，
两个坐在桌边的少女，谁也没有多看这些果子一眼，哪怕它们属于免费拿取品尝的灵果。
灵气逸散到这种程度，和凡果都没有什么区别了。
不过就是那些仆人用来打发她们的东西。
与赤裸裸的蔑视，也就只差那么一层遮羞布的关系。
她们一个托腮，一个抱臂，低声交谈。
窃窃私语的声音响在院落中，伴随着一点袅袅浮动的竹香，闯入了走到乌衣巷院落大门的方韵儿耳中。
“怎么办，怎么办，三天后就要进行考核了。”
“要是考核不过，我就惨了！”
“真羡慕那些嫡系弟子，考核测试什么的就是走个过场。”
方琳琳焦虑的一直揉捏自己的脸，时不时大喘气，整个人都恨不得趴在桌面上。
她扯着头发，深呼吸着，极力安抚自己心中的躁动。
没办法。
但凡是天赋差一点的旁系，除了那些板上钉钉的天骄，其余人，谁会心平气和的等着考核？
不过也还好。
方琳琳就是面上焦虑抱怨，心里虽然有几分在意和忧愁，但也顶多就是少女的忐忑。
她虽然也是旁系，天资也相当差，但是，她所在的旁系来自于平泽城，虽然非常偏远，但城中方家势大，且现任家主乃是她父亲，对她也颇为疼爱，即便她考核失败了，也不会影响太多。
当然，纵使如此，方琳琳还是希望自己能够通过考核的。
毕竟，考核成功和失败，那在方家完全就是两个待遇。
若是能够成功，她父亲自然也有更多的理由扶持她了，而不至于像是现在这样，稍微给她点什么，都要被计较半天。
而另外一名女子，则是冷着脸，抱臂冷笑了一下。
只看她的外貌，很容易让人惊讶。
虽说修士并不太在意凡人规矩，但是，凡是修道，必当修完美道。
剑道，刀道，琴音之道，道道完美，道心无暇，方为上佳。
也因此，修士会更为在意自己的‘完整’。
鲜少会有修士割断自己的发丝。
但这女子，就有一头如同刀削一般的短发，发丝锋利如割，悬于脖颈之上。
她身上穿的衣袍，也极为不对称，可以说，怎么看怎么怪异。
让人不禁怀疑，她是不是走的那条极为艰难险阻的‘残缺’之道。
抱臂冷笑过后，方钰毫不客气开口点评。
“你还是收起幻想吧。”
“你的天资虽然不怎么样，但努力努力，还是有机会能够通过的。”
“若是继续在这里焦灼，心态不稳，便是失败，也是咎由自取。”
这话也是难听。
但方琳琳却不生气，完全习以为常，甚至还扬起笑脸凑过去蹭了蹭方钰的胳膊，搂着她撒娇。
“哎呀，我就知道小钰最好了，谢谢小钰的安慰。”
换来的，是方钰的一个白眼。
但是却并未推开她。
二人如此的熟稔，当然不是几天的功夫。
方琳琳和方钰皆来自于平泽城。
但是，和方琳琳不同，方钰的天资极为出众，是能够住到银霜巷的资质。
不过，她拒绝了所有方家主脉嫡系子弟的邀请，干脆的拿了乌衣巷的令牌，住到了方琳琳的身边。
content_en:
At the same time, in the courtyard in Wuyi Lane.
There is a plate of sparse fruits on the sapphire Langya table, and the spiritual energy in it has almost completely dissipated.
Neither of the two girls sitting at the table took a second look at these fruits, even though they were free tasting spiritual fruits.
The spiritual energy has escaped to such an extent that it is no different from the ordinary fruit.
It's just what the servants used to send them away.
It is only a fig leaf away from naked contempt.
One of them held his chin, the other crossed his arms, and talked in low voices.
Whispering sounds echoed in the courtyard, and along with a bit of the fragrance of bamboo floating in the air, they broke into the ears of Fang Yun'er who walked to the gate of the Wuyi Lane courtyard.
"What to do, what to do, there will be an assessment in three days."
"If I fail the test, I'll be in trouble!"
"I really envy those direct disciples. Assessments and tests are just a formality."
Fang Linlin kept rubbing her face anxiously, panting heavily from time to time, and she wanted to lie down on the table.
She pulled her hair, took a deep breath, and tried her best to calm the restlessness in her heart.
no way.
As for those who are less talented, except for those who are certain to be talented, who will wait calmly for the assessment?
But that's okay.
Fang Linlin was worried and complaining on her face. Although she was a little concerned and worried in her heart, it was just like a girl's anxiety at most.
Although she is also a side clan and her talent is quite poor, her side clan comes from Pingze City. Although it is very remote, the Fang family in the city is powerful, and the current head of the family is her father, who also loves her very much. Even if she fails the assessment, it will not have too much impact.
Of course, even so, Fang Linlin still hoped that she could pass the assessment.
After all, success and failure in the assessment are completely different treatments in the Fang family.
If she can succeed, her father will naturally have more reasons to support her, and he will not be like now, giving her even a little bit will be fussed over for a long time.
The other woman, with a cold face, crossed her arms and sneered.
Just looking at her appearance, it is easy to be surprised.
Although monks don't care much about mortal rules, whenever they practice Taoism, they must cultivate the Tao perfectly.
The way of swordsmanship, the way of swordsmanship, and the way of harp music are the best when they are perfect and have a flawless heart.
Therefore, monks will pay more attention to their own 'integrity'.
It was rare for a monk to cut his own hair.
But this woman had short hair that was as sharp as a knife, and the hair was as sharp as a cut, hanging on her neck.
The robe she was wearing was also extremely asymmetrical. It could be said that it looked weird no matter how it looked.
One can't help but wonder if she followed the extremely difficult and dangerous 'incomplete' path.
After crossing his arms and sneering, Fang Yu commented without any politeness.
"You'd better put away your fantasies."
"Although your talent is not very good, if you work hard, you still have a chance to pass."
"If you continue to be anxious here and have an unstable mentality, it will be a failure and you will bring it upon yourself."
This is also unpleasant to hear.
But Fang Linlin was not angry. She was completely used to it. She even raised a smile and leaned over to rub Fang Yu's arm, hugging her and acting coquettishly.
"Oh, I knew Xiaoyu was the best, thank you Xiaoyu for your comfort."
What he got in return was a blank look from Fang Yu.
But he didn't push her away.
The two of them were so familiar with each other, and it certainly took more than a few days.
Fang Linlin and Fang Yu are both from Pingze City.
However, unlike Fang Linlin, Fang Yu's talent is extremely outstanding, and he has the qualifications to live in Yinshuang Lane.
However, she rejected all the invitations from the direct descendants of the main line of the Fang family, simply took the token of Wuyi Lane and lived next to Fang Linlin.
